course_title: Advanced Nursing Practices in Long-Term Care
course_description: This workshop covers advanced nursing practices specifically tailored for long-term care settings. Topics include patient management, infection control, and regulatory compliance.
teaching_methods: Lectures, case studies, group discussions, and hands-on practical sessions
instructor_education: Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) from the University of Michigan
instructor_teaching_experience: 15 years of teaching experience in nursing education
instructor_experience_in_long_term_care: 20 years of clinical experience in long-term care settings
